subject: Request: One-time invoicing cadence & payment-window waiver for ApexSys (Q3 launch)
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@apexsys.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice cadence & payment-window preference (ApexSys purchase order attached)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the walk-through yesterday — the product looks like a good fit for our Q3 integration. Procurement asked me to confirm ApexSys's preferred billing cadence: we bill quarterly to align with our internal milestone schedules and run a centralized treasury cycle with a 90-day payment window (Net-90).

We understand Redwood's standard is monthly Net-30, but because this contract will be paid from a central pool, our FP&A team requires:
- Quarterly consolidated invoices (end-of-quarter)
- Net-90 payment terms

Attached is our PO and a proposed payment schedule tied to three milestones across Q3/Q4 (ApexSys_PO.pdf & ApexSys_payment_schedule_proposal.xlsx). Total committed ARR for year one is $450,000.

Can your team confirm whether Redwood can accommodate this one-time exception for ApexSys? If helpful, we can offer a 2% early-pay discount if payments are settled within 30 days of invoice.

Best,
Anika Rao
Head of Procurement | ApexSys
Anika.Rao@apexsys.ai

Attachments: ApexSys_PO.pdf, ApexSys_payment_schedule_proposal.xlsx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice cadence & payment-window preference (ApexSys purchase order attached)

Ben / Marissa — forwarding request from ApexSys (deal DX-4837). Key points:
- $450k ARR, strategic ISV partner with Q3 launch window.
- Procurement requires quarterly invoicing + Net-90.
- External offered 2% early-pay discount for payments within 30 days.
- Proposal attached: payment schedule tied to three milestones.

Recommended mitigations to reduce finance risk:
1) Require first quarter payment to be escrowed or pre-funded before launch OR secure signed PO referencing the schedule and acceptance criteria.
2) Approve quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for this account on a one-time basis only, subject to exec sign-off and a written amendment to SOW.
3) Offer a 2% early-pay discount as a concession to encourage faster payment.

Ask: Can finance/legal approve this structure (quarterly invoicing + Net-90) for ApexSys with the mitigations above? If yes, Marissa — can you provide exec sign-off so we can proceed with contract amendment and billing setup?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Tessa.Morgan@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice cadence & payment-window preference (ApexSys purchase order attached)

Thanks, Tessa. Quick assessment from finance:

Summary:
- Upside: $450k ARR; strategic timing (Q3 launch) justifies some flexibility.
- Risk: Net-90 and quarterly consolidate > longer DSO and larger exposure if product acceptance delayed.

We recommend conditional approval with the following controls:
- Require an executed PO referencing the payment schedule and SLAs (we have PO attached but need it countersigned).
- Place first quarter invoice in escrow (or require 50% prepayment) to cover potential ramp risk — escrow is preferred.
- Limit the one-time concession: annotate the contract that future renewals revert to standard monthly Net-30 unless separate approval is granted.

I attached a short risk memo outlining cash exposure and recommended mitigations.

If Marissa provides exec sign-off to the conditions above, finance will route billing to implement a quarterly invoice cadence and flag receivables for expedited collection.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
Ben.Carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: Risk_Assessment_ApexSys.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice cadence & payment-window preference (ApexSys purchase order attached)

Tessa / Ben — I reviewed the deal and Ben's assessment. Executive decision: APPROVE the one-time exception for quarterly invoicing and Net-90 on these conditions (sign-off below):

Conditions (must be satisfied before billing):
1) ApexSys countersigns the attached PO (or SOW amendment) explicitly listing the quarterly schedule and the three milestone acceptance criteria.
2) First quarterly invoice (Q3 kickoff milestone) must be placed in escrow or prepaid at 50% — finance to confirm escrow vendor details.
3) Include a contractual clause reverting terms to our standard Net-30 monthly billing at renewal unless otherwise approved in writing by Sales Leader + Finance.
4) 2% early-pay discount is acceptable; include it in the amendment as an incentive, not a permanent T&Cs change.

Please document this with an exec memo and attach to the HubSpot deal record (DX-4837). Ben, Tessa — move forward with contract amendment and billing setup once the PO is countersigned.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
Marissa.Cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: exec_approval_memo.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & payment-window preference (ApexSys purchase order attached)

Hi Anika —

Thanks for sending the PO and the payment schedule. We can accommodate a one-time quarterly invoicing cadence and Net-90 for ApexSys subject to a few conditions our finance and sales leadership approved: 

1) ApexSys to countersign the attached PO (or SOW amendment) explicitly listing the quarterly milestone schedule and acceptance criteria.
2) First-quarter invoice will need to be placed in escrow (preferred) or 50% prepaid prior to go-live.
3) This is a one-time concession; standard terms revert to Net-30 monthly at renewal.
4) We will include a 2% early-pay discount for invoices settled within 30 days.

If this looks acceptable, please countersign the PO and confirm the escrow approach (we can provide vendor details). Once countersigned, finance will provision the quarterly invoice schedule and we will update the contract.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line for your Q3 launch.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
